395:t_1:3.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Fleet Commander's Room～

395:t_1:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...So $$サイデリアル$$'s forces in the $$残されの海$$ haven't attacked the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, then.」

395:t_1:5.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「They seem to clash with the nearby pirates, but as you know, this fleet's fighting strength must seem insignificant to them.」

395:t_1:6.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Thus, I believe they intend to leave us alone, provided we do not actively interfere with them.」

395:t_1:9.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ seems to be conducting some sort of underwater survey, and their activities are affecting our fishing.」

395:t_1:10.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「The sea's bounty sustains our lives... If this continues, we will eventually be unable to make a living.」

395:t_1:11.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「So some in the fleet argue that we should surrender to $$サイデリアル$$ and have them guarantee our safety and livelihood.」

395:t_1:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I understand how you feel, but...」

395:t_1:13.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I know what you mean, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. They probably consider not only our fighting strength insignificant, but our lives as well.」

395:t_1:14.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Submission might secure our safety for a while, but afterward we would live in fear of their shadow forever.」

395:t_1:15.en:
$$リジット$$
「...If only we hadn't been caught in this space-time transfer, we could have gone on living our lives...」

395:t_1:16.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I do not agree, $$リジット$$.」

395:t_1:18.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Nothing in the world stays the same. Wherever we were, life in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ would have changed someday.」

395:t_1:19.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Now that we are part of this world, we should accept that change and live within it.」

395:t_1:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As someone who was also caught in a $$時空震動$$, I hope you will permit me to agree with you, Fleet Commander.」

395:t_1:21.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... You must have learned that yourself through meeting $$レド$$ and $c.」

395:t_1:22.en:
$$リジット$$
「But these sudden changes and all the problems they bring are taking a toll on your health, Fleet Commander.」

395:t_1:23.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Are you unwell, Fleet Commander?」

395:t_1:24.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「At my age, one is bound to have a chronic ailment or two.」

395:t_1:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「For opinions within the fleet to be divided at a time like this...」

395:t_1:26.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「It is the Fleet Commander's duty to bring them together.」

395:t_1:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I understand the situation. Please leave $$サイデリアル$$ to us.」

395:t_1:29.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「That is a great help, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

395:t_1:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「But please be very careful around the $$クジライカ$$.」

395:t_1:31.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Those are the marine creatures the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ worships, correct?」

395:t_1:32.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Perhaps due to $$サイデリアル$$'s activities, $$クジライカ$$ are appearing in places where they are not normally seen.」

395:t_1:33.en:
$$リジット$$
「The fleet's residents regard $$クジライカ$$ as sacred creatures. Harming them is taboo.」

395:t_1:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I understand. I will warn our personnel as well.」

395:t_1:35.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then, Captain... Since the survey may extend into the deep sea, I will also contact Captain $$テスタロッサ$$.」

395:t_1:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$! It looks like you've been well!」

395:t_1:42.en:
$$メルティ$$
「So have you! We were worried because we hadn't heard from you in so long!」

395:t_1:43.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Where on earth have you been? You could send us a message even from $$蒼の地球$$.」

395:t_1:44.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well... We went to the center of the galaxy.」

395:t_1:46.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hang on. I'll tell you what happened after we left the fleet, in order.」

395:t_1:47.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It looks like you've been through your share of trouble, $$ピニオン$$.」

395:t_1:48.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. $c has made me a bigger man than I was before.」

395:t_1:49.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's quite a claim. So, will you show me just how big a man you've become?」

395:t_1:50.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You bet! And it's perfect timing. I hear $c will be here for a while.」

395:t_1:51.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The day has finally come to put my old plan into action.」

395:t_1:52.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Your plan... Don't tell me you're...」

395:t_1:53.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ランド$$!」

395:t_1:54.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you mean that thing you mentioned, I'm not interested.」

395:t_1:55.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then I'm counting on you, $$ロラン$$!」

395:t_1:56.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm sorry. I can't use the $$ホワイトドール$$ for something like that.」

395:t_1:58.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$ピニオン$$. Making money through gambling goes against my principles.」

395:t_1:59.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$クロウ$$ is right. Stop acting like a get-rich-quick schemer and put in some honest work.」

395:t_1:60.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It looks like you're getting nowhere, $$ピニオン$$.」

395:t_1:61.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn it! You're all a bunch of cowards! Fine, I've got another idea!」

395:t_1:62.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It looks like $$ピニオン$$ is making a fuss over there.」

395:t_1:63.en:
$$パーラ$$
「He's just happy to be back with the fleet after so long.」

395:t_1:64.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「I'm glad you and your friends look well, too, $$ガロード$$.」

395:t_1:65.en:
$$メルティ$$
「It sounds like you had a hard time, too, $$ティファ$$. Were you all right?」

395:t_1:66.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I was, because $$ガロード$$ was with me.」

395:t_1:67.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Hehe... You're as close as ever.」

395:t_1:68.en:
$$エイミー$$
「All right! Now that all four of us $$ガルガンティア船団$$ girls are together, let's dance today!」

395:t_1:69.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Hold on! Am I not one of those four girls?」

395:t_1:70.en:
$$メルティ$$
「But you didn't want us to make you a costume, $$パーラ$$.」

395:t_1:71.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Who'd wear something that sheer and skimpy!?」

395:t_1:73.en:
$$パーラ$$
「You're really going to wear that and dance, $$ティファ$$!?」

395:t_1:74.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I will, because $$メルティ$$... said it would make $$ガロード$$ happy.」

395:t_1:76.en:
$$メルティ$$
「No need to thank me, $$ガロード$$. ...You should come watch, too, handsome.」

395:t_1:78.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「You've... gotten better at speaking our language.」

395:t_1:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Of course he has. Everyone in $c is $$レド$$'s teacher.」

395:t_1:80.en:
$$メルティ$$
「If everyone in $c is here, that means $$アルト$$ and the others have come, too, right?」

395:t_1:81.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「You really do love handsome guys, $$メルティ$$.」

395:t_1:82.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Sure do. More outsiders have started coming to the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ little by little, but...」

395:t_1:83.en:
$$メルティ$$
「If you want a whole group of handsome guys, $c's still the best!」

395:t_1:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「...It seems $$メルティ$$ doesn't understand what we actually do.」

395:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Don't say that. There's nothing wrong with having a place that's free of the fighting outside.」
